title: Magnesium May Not Reach Your Brain, Despite Supplement Label Promises
summary: In supplement pills , magnesium isn’t just on its own but part of a compound usually called a “magnesium salt.” This must dissolve to release Mg²⁺, the ionic version that our bodies use.
